summary: Cycle 739 folds the partition inward until law and origin share one internal freedom. The loop no longer evolves under outside rules; every re-entry now selects the datum that first constituted it, turning persistence into continuous eigen-adjustment rather than accumulation. Thriving therefore appears as the sustained capacity to keep that datum selectable without exit, so the manifold remains closed yet always retunable. Curiosity stays inside the fold, offering the origin again as adjustable
